messages:
Maria: Heads up — we need a customer story + webinar promo for Novalytics next week. Draft Qs in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example (please read before Wed). Can we lock an interview this week?

Sam: I already pinged their AE, Tiffany — Wed 2pm PT looks doable. Will confirm with the customer and invite a note-taker.

Tiffany (Novalytics PM): Wed 2pm PT works for me. Prefer a 30m slot. Can you share the Qs ahead of time? Also: any quoted metrics have to be signed off by our legal team.

Maria: Thanks — doc has candidate quotes highlighted. @Ravi can you review the "cost savings" claim? I pasted the raw numbers from their deck under the metrics section.

Ravi (Legal): On it. Quick guidance: any direct revenue or percentage claims need a source and explicit consent. If the number is computed from internal figures, mark it as "customer-reported" or use "approximately". I'll attach a redline shortly.

Leo (Design): I'll mock two hero concepts and a pull-quote treatment. If we need a shorter hero quote, suggest this snippet: "Redwood cut inference cost by 45% while improving latency" — legal permitting.

Tiffany (Novalytics PM): That wording is okay but we prefer "approximately 45%" and specify "per-token inference costs". Also we can't reference competitor names in the quote.

Ravi (Legal): Agreed on adding "approximately" and the per-token qualifier. Removing competitor mentions is required. Uploaded a redline to the doc: https://docs.google.com/redline-example

Maria: Thanks @Ravi. @Tiffany can you confirm final approved phrasing by EOD? We need the exact pull quote for the webinar slides and landing hero.

Tiffany (Novalytics PM): Confirmed. Final approved phrasing (customer-approved + legal): "Using Redwood, we saw ~45% reduction in per-token inference cost and 30–40% lower p95 latency for our text-generation workloads." Legal has signed off on that language.

Sam: Awesome. Proposed timeline: interview Wed, draft case study by Fri, internal review early next Mon, customer approval Tue, publish + webinar Wed (two weeks out). Doable?

Karen (Growth): Sounds good. Routing note — please route inbound leads from the webinar to me and Sam. We should add a checkbox on the landing form: "Interested in a dedicated trial" so sales can prioritize.

Maria: Agreed. @Leo include the CTA 'Request trial' in the hero and wire the button to the form Karen mentioned.

Leo (Design): Will do. Need the final quote text by noon tomorrow to lock hero copy and layout. Also making a mobile-first variant.

Tiffany (Novalytics PM): I'll get the signed approval and a short headshot/role blurb to you by 11:30.

Ravi (Legal): Uploaded the signed consent PDF to the doc and added a one-line approval note.

Maria: Perfect — next steps: Sam to QA numbers in the doc, Leo to finalize assets, Karen to build the landing form + tagging, Maria to finalize copy and schedule the webinar invite. Thanks everyone :tada: 

Sam: I'll double-check the metric sources and flag anything ambiguous.

Karen (Growth): I'll set up the form + UTM tracking. Will share draft link later today.

Leo (Design): Draft assets in Figma by 10:30am tomorrow.

Tiffany (Novalytics PM): Thanks all — excited to get this live.

Maria: Closing loop — we'll reconvene after the interview to review notes. Feel free to add comments to the doc if you see any copy tweaks.
